tbesh_html:
1) to be or become rich or wealthy, enrich, pretend to be rich
1a) (Qal) to be or become rich
1b) (Hiphil)
1b1) to make rich
1b2) to gain riches
1c) (Hithpael) to enrich oneself, pretend to be rich

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to accumulate; chiefly (specifically) to grow (causatively, make) rich
strongs_1890.kjv_def: be(-come, en-, make, make self, wax) rich, make (1 Kings 22:48 marg). See H6240 (עָשָׂר).
